label: Financial information
detail: Alleged accurate financial-information disclosures, including revenue, related parties and operating costs.

label: Manager remuneration
detail: Alleged contractual disclosure of manager remuneration.

label: Player remuneration
detail: Alleged contractual disclosure of player remuneration.

label: UEFA compliance
detail: Alleged compliance with UEFA Club Licensing and Financial Fair Play regulations.

label: Profitability and sustainability
detail: Alleged Premier League profitability and sustainability breaches.

label: Cooperation
detail: Alleged failure to cooperate with the Premier League investigation.

label: CAS decision
detail: CAS set aside UEFA's two-season exclusion. It found a non-cooperation breach and imposed a EUR10m fine. This was not a decision on the Premier League allegations.

label: FY2023-24 accounts
detail: Revenue £715.0m. Net profit £73.8m. The financial year ended 30 June 2024.

label: FY2024-25 accounts
detail: Revenue £694.1m. Net loss £9.9m. The financial year ended 30 June 2025.
